paragraphs: Avail Technologies sells enterprise transit management software to public transit agencies. The company states that its target market is transit operators with medium-sized fleets.

The myAvail platform covers vehicle location, dispatching, workforce management, reporting, and rider communications, so a team works from one connected system rather than several tools. A single shared database moves data throughout the organization. Dispatchers see where every bus and driver is, and incidents are tracked as they occur. Business intelligence dashboards report metrics in real time, which the company frames as a way to improve efficiency, justify funding requests, and demonstrate compliance. Features can be added to the platform as an agency's needs grow, and the company says myAvail ships multiple platform updates a year.

Founded in 1999, Avail describes a family-oriented staff working hand-in-hand with transit professionals. It says it has stayed a mid-sized company by design. An announcement on the site names Rick Spangler as president and chief executive as the company continues a transition to full employee ownership.

quote.text: myAvail was built on a simple belief: your data should give you answers, not just numbers to interpret.
